classroom.title: Classroom · UniSkilled
classroom.check-your-camera-and: Check your camera and microphone, then join your lesson.
classroom.your-video-and-audio: Your video and audio go directly between you and the other person. UniSkilled does not record lessons.
classroom.messages-and-files-go: Messages and files go directly between you two and are not saved. Download any file you want to keep.
classroom.you-can-rejoin-at: You can rejoin at any time while the lesson is open.
classroom.tap-a-star-to: Tap a star to rate. It takes 20 seconds and helps other students.
classroom.rejoin-back-to-dashboard: Back to dashboard
classroom.microphone-level.title: Microphone level
classroom.share-a-file-up.title: Share a file (up to 25 MB)
classroom.js.missing-lesson: This classroom link is missing the lesson. Open it from your dashboard.
classroom.js.opens-at: The classroom opens 10 minutes before your lesson, at {{time}}.
classroom.js.cam-missing: Camera not available. Tap the camera button to try again, or join with audio only.
classroom.js.join-failed: Could not connect to the classroom. Check your internet connection and try again.
classroom.js.connect-when: We'll connect you as soon as {{name}} joins. Keep this page open.
classroom.js.is-here: {{name}} is here. Setting up the call…
classroom.js.dropped: The connection dropped. We're reconnecting you automatically.
classroom.js.send-failed: Couldn't be sent — the connection dropped. Please try again.
classroom.js.receive-failed: Couldn't be received — the connection dropped. Please try again.
classroom.js.chat-later: Chat is available once you're connected.
classroom.js.no-screen: Screen sharing isn't supported on this device.
classroom.js.max-file: Files can be up to 25 MB.
classroom.js.files-later: You can share files once you're connected.
classroom.js.media-unsupported: This browser can't use a camera or microphone here. Please open the lesson in Safari or Chrome (not inside another app).
classroom.js.media-blocked-both: Access to your camera and microphone is blocked. Allow it in your browser settings for uniskilled.com, then tap the camera button to try again.
classroom.js.media-blocked-cam: Access to your camera is blocked. Allow it in your browser settings for uniskilled.com, then tap the camera button to try again.
classroom.js.media-blocked-mic: Access to your microphone is blocked. Allow it in your browser settings for uniskilled.com, then tap the microphone button to try again.
classroom.js.media-busy-both: Your camera and microphone is busy (for example a phone call or another app is using it). End the call or close the other app, then tap the camera button to try again.
classroom.js.media-busy-cam: Your camera is busy (for example a phone call or another app is using it). End the call or close the other app, then tap the camera button to try again.
classroom.js.media-busy-mic: Your microphone is busy (for example a phone call or another app is using it). End the call or close the other app, then tap the microphone button to try again.
classroom.js.media-missing-both: No camera and microphone was found on this device. You can still join and see and hear the other person.
classroom.js.media-missing-cam: No camera was found on this device. You can still join and see and hear the other person.
classroom.js.media-missing-mic: No microphone was found on this device. You can still join and see and hear the other person.
classroom.js.media-failed-both: Your camera and microphone couldn't be started. Tap the camera button to try again. You can also join without it.
classroom.js.media-failed-cam: Your camera couldn't be started. Tap the camera button to try again. You can also join without it.
classroom.js.media-failed-mic: Your microphone couldn't be started. Tap the microphone button to try again. You can also join without it.
